title: The Morning Digest: October 13, 2026
dek: Russia hit at least six Ukrainian energy targets on Monday, and Kyiv said Moscow is unwilling to accept the energy ceasefire announced Sunday. The market faded the announcement: Brent settled at $106.65 on Monday, its highest settle since September 15, before the overnight session gave back $1.69 on WTI and $1.58 on Brent on the prospect of Russian diesel supply. The diesel crack held above $100 for a seventh straight day at $104.46. Riyadh airport stayed closed all Monday with no reopening date, and Saudi Arabia's energy minister said the response must be equally serious. Gulf shut-ins from Hurricane Isaias fell to 29.63% of oil production on Monday. Canadian differentials had no price discovery on Monday: the ICE settles are a holiday carry, unchanged on zero volume.
